Later, two little stick figures wait under slowly descending ropes and talk: "tujhe pta hai aaj iss ladki ka birthday hai?" — "kis ladki ka?" — "ye jo humne itni der se ghoor rahi hai" — "mujhe to ye creepy lagg rahi hai..." — "hume ghoorna band karogi?" (the scene pauses and asks you: yas / nahi — say nahi and the right one switches the lights off until you say sorry) — "kabhi humare jaise logs nhi dekhe kya?" Then they hold the ropes, jump down, and run away shouting "bhaagoo".
